result.summary: The page is mostly visually intact, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains two identical side-by-side restaurant cards, which looks like a content duplication bug.

issues.description: Two consecutive cards in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel show the exact same restaurant name ('Green Bowl Poké'), delivery fee (€0.90), time label, and food image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate listing or provide distinct content (unique restaurant name, image, and details) for each carousel item so the carousel does not appear broken.
